text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A vacancy opened up in his mother's 
orchestra, so Sounds of Earth ended up 
stepping in as a substitute for one day.
choice_data_list: I pray it goes smoothly and succeeds...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"This excitement... meraviglioso...!! Heh, 
I won't be outdone either—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: !? Ngh... My arm, I can't lift it...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To think my body... cannot keep up with 
the "sound"... ...And yet...

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
!? Angelo, you can barely stand...! You 
gave that performance in that 
condition...!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It played within my heart. A 
symphony that cheers me on—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My memories with you, Direttore... Each 
and every one is a passionate melodia.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My memories with you, Direttrice... Each 
and every one is a passionate melodia.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Those days, that music. They were what 
inspired me.

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Come on, make sure you stay hydrated. 
And—make sure to properly thank them."

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
To Trainer-san, waiting for the encore 
from the stands!

text_block_list.name: Earth's Mother
text_block_list.text:
To Trainer-san, waiting for the encore 
from the stands!
